# CVGrid App & API Reference

> CVGrid (https://cvgrid.in / https://app.cvgrid.in) is an AI-powered resume builder, ATS score checker, and career acceleration suite.

## Web Application Tools & Endpoints

- [Resume Builder](https://app.cvgrid.in/): Interactive step-by-step resume editor with real-time preview and AI bullet point generation.
- [Resume Templates](https://app.cvgrid.in/templates): 18+ ATS-compliant templates (Classic, Modern, Executive, Developer, Minimalist, etc.).
- [ATS Score Checker](https://app.cvgrid.in/ats-checker): Scan your resume against job postings for keyword gaps and ATS compatibility.
- [AI Cover Letter Generator](https://app.cvgrid.in/cover-letter): Generate role-targeted cover letters in seconds.
- [AI Match Score](https://app.cvgrid.in/ai-tools/match-score): Deep match analysis against job descriptions.
- [AI Keyword Optimizer](https://app.cvgrid.in/ai-tools/keyword-optimizer): Identify missing keywords and hard skills.
- [AI Interview Question Generator](https://app.cvgrid.in/ai-tools/interview-generator): Role-specific interview prep.
- [Portfolio Builder](https://app.cvgrid.in/ai-tools/portfolio-builder): Convert resumes into clean web portfolios.

## Pricing & Transparency

- Free Tier: 100% free resume creation and watermark-free PDF downloads.
- Premium Upgrade: Single one-time fee of ₹150 INR (~$1.80 USD). No subscriptions.
